title: Fresh separate Phase3 portfolio architecture proposal
summary: Separate architect consolidated the complete accepted research inventory into seven conditional scenario targets and 37 unique public recordsets. All 682 original candidate IDs/history and 1170 assertions are preserved;679 candidate files and all assertion files remain byte-identical, with three ROR rights-only clarifications; 57 original scenarios/bundles have explicit dispositions. No semantic reconciliation, canonical mutation, implementation, publication, gate pass or independent adversarial acceptance.
